tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List your ordered backlinks with status and published URL.

tools.name: get_basket
tools.description: List what is currently in your basket (inspect the drafted articles/placements before publishing).

tools.name: publish_basket
tools.description: Publish everything in your basket, paying from your account balance. If the balance is short it does nothing and reports how much more is needed. Topping up the balance is done in the dashboard only.

tools.name: send_invoice
tools.description: Email an existing invoice or proforma (exact number from list_invoices, e.g. RX-2026-000123 or PF-2026-000007) with its PDF link — to the invoice email, or to "to".

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_links, get_article_prompt, order_backlink, list_invoices · Private data: list_invoices · Public sink: order_backlink, publish_basket, list_invoices, issue_proforma, send_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_links, get_article_prompt, order_backlink, list_invoices · Private data: list_invoices · Public sink: order_backlink, publish_basket, list_invoices, issue_proforma, send_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
